    24  * `IsStable`: A property of stochastic processes is said to be stable if it is

    11  /-!
    12  # Indicator function
    13  
    14  This file defines the indicator function of a set. More lemmas can be found in
    15  `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Indicator.lean`.
    16  
    17  ## Main declarations
    18  
    19  - `Set.indicator (s : Set α) (f : α → β) (a : α)` is `f a` if `a ∈ s` and is `0` otherwise.
    20  - `Set.mulIndicator (s : Set α) (f : α → β) (a : α)` is `f a` if `a ∈ s` and is `1` otherwise.
    21  
    22  ## Implementation note
    23  
    24  In mathematics, an indicator function or a characteristic function is a function
    25  used to indicate membership of an element in a set `s`,
    26  having the value `1` for all elements of `s` and the value `0` otherwise.
    27  But since it is usually used to restrict a function to a certain set `s`,
    28  we let the indicator function take the value `f x` for some function `f`, instead of `1`.
    29  If the usual indicator function is needed, just set `f` to be the constant function `fun _ ↦ 1`.
    30  
    31  The indicator function is implemented non-computably, to avoid having to pass around `Decidable`
    32  arguments. This is in contrast with the design of `Pi.single` or `Set.piecewise`.
